def f(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    from collections import Counter,defaultdict
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r); bg=max(cnt,key=cnt.get)
    pts=defaultdict(list)
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if g[r][c]!=bg: pts[g[r][c]].append((r,c))
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    done=set(); groups=[]
    allcells=set()
    for col,cs in pts.items(): allcells|=set(cs)
    for a in sorted(allcells):
        if a in done: continue
        grp={a}; stack=[a]; done.add(a)
        while stack:
            p=stack.pop()
            cp=None
            for col,cs2 in list(pts.items()):
                if p in cs2: cp=col; break
            S=set(pts[cp])
            for dr,dc in ((1,-1),(1,1)):
                q=(p[0]+dr,p[1]+dc)
                if q in S and q not in done:
                    done.add(q); grp.add(q); stack.append(q)
        groups.append((cp,grp))
    for cp,grp in groups:
        if len(grp)<2: continue
        minp=min(grp); maxp=max(grp)
        sgn1 = 1 if maxp[0]>minp[0] else -1
        sgn2 = 1 if maxp[1]>minp[1] else -1
        dirs=[(-sgn1,-sgn2),(sgn1,sgn2)]
        for e,d in zip([minp,maxp],dirs):
            rr,cc=e[0]+d[0],e[1]+d[1]
            while 0<=rr<h and 0<=cc<w and out[rr][cc]==bg:
                out[rr][cc]=cp; rr+=d[0]; cc+=d[1]
